title: User Guide
text: This guide provides the basic instructions for using the AFM Grain Analysis web application. The application allows users to upload AFM data, select the appropriate data channel, adjust the grain-detection parameters, review the detected grains, and download the resulting grain mask and statistical analysis.

title: User Guide

3×3 Processing
Threshold sensitivity
Controls the selectivity of the initial boundary detection performed using the 3×3 processing path.
Minimum component size
Removes small detected components below the specified size.

Threshold sensitivity

title: User Guide
text:
Reconstruction and Cleaning
Endpoint trace steps
Controls the number of pixels used to estimate the direction of incomplete grain boundaries.
Maximum complement steps
Controls the maximum distance over which the algorithm can extend an incomplete boundary using information from the complementary detection path.
Minimum cycle size
Removes small closed structures below the specified size from the final grain-boundary mask.

title: AFM Grain Analysis
text:
Overview
AFM Grain Analysis is a Python-based tool for grain boundary detection and quantitative grain analysis from Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) images.
The analysis workflow includes:

AFM data import
Multi-scale Laplacian convolution
Automatic thresholding
Binary mask filtering
Skeletonization
Grain boundary reconstruction
Grain identification
Statistical analysis



Web Application
The grain analysis tool is available through the Streamlit web application.


Documentation
This documentation describes the grain detection methodology, adjustable parameters, statistical analysis, and usage of the web application.

title: Methodology
text:
Grain Detection Workflow
The grain detection method processes AFM height data through a sequence of image-processing steps.
The main stages are:

AFM data import
Laplacian convolution
Automatic thresholding
Small-component filtering
Skeletonization
Endpoint detection
Skeleton complementation
Bridge removal
Closed-cycle filtering
Grain identification
Border-grain removal

title: Statistical Analysis
text:
Grain Statistics
The program calculates geometric and topographic properties for each detected grain.
